home.title: Home
home.intro: Watches regulators for rule changes, decides which apply to one specific business, and turns each into a dated obligation.
home.signInPrompt: Sign in to see your businesses and their obligations.
sitemap.title: All screens
sitemap.intro: Every screen the app knows about, whether it is available yet, and the backend route it waits for.
legal.title: Legal
legal.intro: The documents below are drafts; the version on each one is what a consent records.
legal.unknown: There is no legal document with that name.
forbidden.title: You cannot open this page
forbidden.body: Your role does not include this screen. Ask a tenant admin if you need it.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.devIntro: Development sign-in: choose a tenant kind, the roles and a display name.
signIn.devNotice: Nothing is verified here. This form exists only where CW_WEB_ENV is local or test; the real sign-in arrives with the identity service.
signIn.rolesHelp: Choose at least one of the roles this tenant kind allows.
signIn.tenantIdHelp: Leave empty for a new tenant, or paste the id of an existing one.
signIn.unavailableNoForm: The configured provider offers no sign-in method this app can show yet.

account.intro: What your session carries. Name, phone and email arrive with the identity service.
account.mfaAsserted: Asserted by the development sign-in, not verified
account.profileNote: Profile fields (name, phone, email, the tenants you belong to) arrive with the identity service's /me route.

notAvailable.none: No backend exists for this tool yet.
notAvailable.ready: The backend for this screen is on main. The screen itself has not been built yet.

notFound.body: There is nothing at this address.

error.body: The page could not be rendered. Try again, and quote the reference below if it keeps failing.
error.unavailable: The service is not available right now.

error.globalTitle: The page could not be shown
admin.title: Internal tools

design.title: Design system
design.intro: Every component of the UI kit in every state, with example text.
attribute.error.chooseAtLeastOne: Tick at least one, or answer Not sure or Does not apply.
attribute.error.wholeNumber: Enter a whole number, such as 12.
attribute.error.date: Enter a date as day, month and year.
attribute.error.year: This answer is stated for a financial year, and none was given.
answer.notApplicableHelp: Does not apply opens a review task an analyst will look at.
reviewTask.reason.not_applicable: You said this does not apply; an analyst will confirm
reviewTask.reason.confirm_financial_year: Confirm this value for the new financial year
reviewTask.reason.verify_registration: GSTIN details not verified by a lookup provider
consent.checkbox.terms: I accept the terms of service.
consent.checkbox.privacy_notice: I have read the privacy notice.
consent.checkbox.profile_processing: Use the business identifiers and the profile answers I give to work out which GST obligations apply to the business and when they are due.
consent.checkbox.whatsapp_reminders: Send me GST reminders for this business on WhatsApp. I can reply STOP at any time.
consent.checkbox.email_reminders: Send me reminders for this business by email.
consent.checkbox.analytics: Record which screens I open and which steps I finish, to improve the app.
consent.intro: Before you add a business, agree to the terms and the privacy notice. Each agreement is recorded with the version of the document it refers to and the time.
consent.whatsappNumberHelp: With the country code, starting with +. The notification service records the opt-in for this number.
consent.caFirmNote: WhatsApp reminders are set for each client business, not for the firm.
consent.error.whatsappNumber: Enter the number with its country code, starting with +.
consent.error.whatsappNumberMissing: Enter the WhatsApp number the reminders go to.
consent.error.whatsappNotOffered: WhatsApp reminders are set for each client business, not for the firm.
consent.partial: Recorded before the failure: {purposes}. Agree again to record the rest; a purpose already recorded is not recorded twice.
consent.partialNone: Nothing was recorded before the failure.
consent.preferenceFailed: Your consents are recorded, but the WhatsApp number is not opted in yet. Agree again to retry.
consent.accepted.title: You have agreed to the current documents
consent.appendOnly: Consent records are append-only: nothing here edits or deletes one, and a withdrawal is recorded as a new record.
consent.draft: {documents}. The wording has not been approved and may change; what you agree to is recorded with these versions.
businessStep.intro: Add the business by its GSTIN. The business is made from the PAN inside the GSTIN, and the registration is filled in from the GSTIN lookup where one is connected.
businessStep.gstinHelp: 15 characters, starting with the two-digit state code. The built-in static lookup of a local stack knows only the demo GSTIN 29ABCDE1234F1Z5; without a lookup provider nothing is filled in and a review task is opened instead.
businessStep.name: Business name
businessStep.nameHelp: The name the business goes by.
businessStep.registrationNameHelp: A name for this GSTIN, such as a branch; the business name when left empty.
businessStep.consentFirst: A business profile is processed on the strength of your consents. Record them on the consent step, then come back here.
businessStep.error.gstin: Enter the GSTIN as 15 characters: the two-digit state code, the PAN, the entity code, Z and a check character.
businessStep.error.name: Enter the name the business goes by.
prefill.applied: Stored on the profile from the GSTIN: {attributes}.
prefill.appliedNone: Nothing new was stored: the profile already held these values.
prefill.notLookedUpTitle: No lookup details for this GSTIN
prefill.notLookedUp: No GSTIN lookup provider returned details for this GSTIN, so nothing was filled in from the registry. You answer the questions yourself.
prefill.reviewTask: A review task was opened so the registration is verified once a provider is connected: {id}.
question.unsureCount: You answered Not sure to {count} of the questions so far. They stay open, are not asked again in this run, and are listed on the summary.
question.savedReviewTask: It opened a review task an analyst will look at; it is listed below.
question.forYear: The answer is for the financial year {fy}.
question.wasUnsure: You answered Not sure to this before. Answer it now, or choose Not sure again to move on.
question.unsupportedTitle: This question cannot be shown here yet
question.unsupported: It needs an answer of the type {type}, which this app has no control for. Stop here and answer it later.
question.stopHere: Stop here and see the summary
question.reviewTasksCaption: Open review tasks on this business
question.reviewTasksNone: No review task is open on this business.
question.error.form: The form was not sent as the page drew it. Reload the page and answer again.
question.error.unknown: This question is not in the ontology the app holds. Reload the page and answer again.
done.intro: {name}, PAN {pan}, GSTIN {gstins}. This is what its profile holds now.
done.reviewTasksCaption: Open review tasks on this business
directory.searchHelp: A name, a PAN or a GSTIN, or part of one; any case.
directory.failed: The list could not be read
directory.noMatchBody: No name, PAN or GSTIN contains "{q}". Search again with less of it, or leave the box empty for the whole list.
directory.owner.intro: The businesses of your account, by name.
directory.owner.emptyBody: Your account has no business on file. Onboarding adds one from its GSTIN.
directory.owner.caption: Businesses of your account
directory.clients.intro: Your firm's client businesses, by name.
directory.clients.emptyBody: Your firm has no client business on file. Onboarding adds one from its GSTIN.
directory.clients.caption: Client businesses of your firm
location.title: Add a location
location.label: Label
location.labelHelp: The code the location is known by under this registration, such as a branch code; 1 to 80 characters.
location.name: Name
location.existing: Location {label} was already under this registration
location.notListed: Locations are not listed here: the profile service has no route that lists a registration's locations yet. A location is reached from the links shown when it is added.
location.error.label: Enter a label.
location.error.name: Enter a name.
location.error.registration: This registration is not part of the business. Reload the page and try again.
business.homeIntro: PAN {pan}. The business, its registrations and how far its profile has got.
business.name: Name
business.onboardingComplete: Every onboarding question has an answer.
business.tile.profileBody: The business by its PAN and its GSTIN registrations ({count}); add a location.
business.tile.attributesBody: {known} answered, {unsure} not sure, {notApplicable} does not apply.
business.tile.snapshotBody: What the applicability engine evaluates, per financial year.
attributes.ownNone: No value is stored on this node for this year.
attributes.inheritedIntro: Values stored higher up the hierarchy apply here too; a value stored on this node wins.
attributes.unansweredNone: Every attribute asked at this level has an answer for this year.
attributes.savedVersion: Saved; the profile is now at version {version}.
attributes.error.role: Your role can read this profile but not change it.
snapshot.intro: This is what the applicability engine evaluates for this node and year: its own values and those it inherits, the nearest node winning.
snapshot.caption: Snapshot for {fy}
snapshot.empty: The snapshot holds no value for this node and year.
reviewTasks.intro: Tasks the profile's answers opened for an analyst: a value said not to apply, a value to confirm for a new financial year, a registration no lookup provider verified. Resolving one is an analyst's action; this page lists them.
reviewTasks.caption: Review tasks on this business
reviewTasks.emptyBody: No answer on this business has opened a task for an analyst.
directory.clients.title: Clients
settings.intro: Your consents, how reminders reach you, billing and your account. A page that is not built yet says which service route it waits for.
settings.about.owner.settings.consents: What you agreed to and when, with every record kept. Give or withdraw reminders and analytics.
settings.about.owner.settings.notificati: Whether reminders reach your WhatsApp number or email, in which language, and the quiet hours when they are held.
settings.about.owner.settings.billing: The plans on offer, and starting a subscription.
settings.about.owner.settings.data_right: Ask for a copy of your data, or for its deletion.
settings.about.owner.settings.team: Invite people, set their roles and disable their access.
settings.about.owner.settings.activity: Who changed what in your account, from the audit trail.
settings.about.ca.settings.webhooks: Send changes to your own systems.
settings.about.ca.settings.api_keys: Keys for calling the service from your own systems.
settings.about.ca.settings.digests: Summaries of changes for your clients.
settings.about.account.home: What your session carries, and signing out.
settings.about.account.mfa: A second step when you sign in.
consentSettings.intro: Each consent is a record with the version of the document it refers to and the time. Nothing here edits a record: giving or withdrawing adds a new one.
consentSettings.draft: {documents}. The wording has not been approved and may change; a record carries the version it refers to.
consentSettings.stateCaption: The latest record for each purpose
consentSettings.whatsappNotOffered: Set for each client business, not for the firm.
consentSettings.requiredNote: Terms of service, the privacy notice and processing of the business profile are what the service runs on. Withdrawing them ends the service, so it is a data rights request:
consentSettings.outdated: Given for an earlier version; the current one is {current}.
consentSettings.historyCaption: Your consent records, oldest first. They are append-only: a withdrawal is a new record, and earlier records stay as they were.
consentSettings.emptyTitle: No consent recorded for you yet
consentSettings.emptyBody: Nothing is on file for you. The terms, the privacy notice and profile processing are asked for when you get started.
consentSettings.emptyBodyNoStep: Nothing is on file for you. Reminders and analytics can be given above.
consentSettings.recordsWithdraw: This adds a record for {purpose} with granted false, the notice version {notice} of the consent it withdraws, the source web_onboarding (the identity service has no settings source), you as the recorder, the sentence below as evidence, and the time. Earlier records stay as they are.
consentSettings.recordsGive: This adds a record for {purpose} with granted true, the notice version {notice}, the source web_onboarding (the identity service has no settings source), you as the recorder, the sentence below as evidence, and the time.
consentSettings.numberWithdrawHelp: With the country code, starting with +. The number is opted out on the notification service, so reminders to it stop. Leave it empty to record the withdrawal only; the number can also reply STOP.
consentSettings.numberGiveHelp: With the country code, starting with +. The notification service opts this number in once the consent is recorded.
consentSettings.error.purpose: This consent is not changed on this page.
consentSettings.error.change: Choose to give or to withdraw the consent.
consentSettings.error.optOutFailed: Nothing was recorded: the number could not be opted out.
consentSettings.error.recordAfterOptOut: The number is opted out, but the withdrawal is not recorded yet. Try again.
consentSettings.error.optInFailed: Your consent is recorded, but the number is not opted in yet. Try again.
consentSettings.done.alreadyWithdrawn: {purpose} was not given, so nothing new was recorded.
consentSettings.done.alreadyGiven: {purpose} was already given for the current version, so nothing new was recorded.
notifications.intro: Whether reminders reach a WhatsApp number or an email address, in which language, and the quiet hours in Indian Standard Time when they are held. Each preference is kept by the notification service for one number or address.
notifications.recipientNote: The identity service does not return your own number and address yet, so name them here. The page remembers them on this device only, until you sign out.
notifications.recipientHelp.whatsapp: With the country code, starting with +.
notifications.recipientHelp.email: The address the reminders go to.
notifications.consentGiven: Your consent to {purpose} is on file.
notifications.consentNotGiven: Your consent to {purpose} is not on file, so reminders cannot be switched on here.
notifications.consentMissing: Give the consent first; the service opts a recipient in only once it is recorded. Switching reminders off and changing the language or the quiet hours work without it.
notifications.emailNote: The notification service does not deliver email yet: its email channel is not connected. A preference is still recorded and applies once it is.
notifications.notRecordedTitle: Nothing is recorded for this recipient
notifications.notRecorded: The notification service sends nothing to a recipient that is not opted in. The form starts from the service's defaults: English, and quiet hours from 21:00 to 08:00 IST.
notifications.languageHelp: The languages the service has message templates in for this channel.
notifications.quietHelp: A reminder due in this window is held and sent when it ends. A window may run past midnight; the same start and end means no quiet hours.
notifications.error.emailMissing: Enter the address the reminders go to.
notifications.error.email: Enter an email address, such as name@example.com.
notifications.error.language: Choose one of the languages listed.
notifications.error.time: Enter a time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock.
notifications.error.consentMissing: Your consent to {purpose} is not on file, so reminders were not switched on. Give it on the Consents page, or choose not to send reminders.
notifications.error.consentMissingField: Reminders can be switched on once your consent is on file.
